lines.zh: 我踩在雪上，雪没有声音
lines.en: I tread the snow and it makes no sound

lines.zh: 翅膀折在背后，走路时张开一点
lines.en: My wings fold behind, opening a little as I walk

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的风，对我没什么
lines.en: The wind of the ice spikes does little to me

lines.zh: 我的爪子留下黑色的印
lines.en: My claws leave dark prints

lines.zh: 我一步一步，冰在脚下裂
lines.en: Step by step, the ice cracks under me

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，雪化成水
lines.en: Where I pass, the snow melts to water
I am tall enough to knock the frost off branches

lines.zh: 雪原太白，我这一身太黑
lines.en: The snowfield is too white, I am too black
I tilt my head at the distant treeline

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，是给你时间
lines.en: I walk slowly, to give you time

lines.zh: 翅膀扇了一下，雪被卷起来
lines.en: One beat of my wings lifts the snow
I move through the snow like a blade

lines.zh: 我站在雪地中间，一动不动
lines.en: I stand in the middle of the snow, unmoving

lines.zh: 我吐出的寒气凝成白雾。
lines.en: The cold I breathe out thickens into white mist.
Cold air spreads off me

lines.zh: 我脚边有一圈没化的雪
lines.en: A ring of unmelted snow lies at my feet
I watch the whiteness far off
This arm is made of ice
I have no need of warmth
There is a bird in the trees, too loud
I open my hand slowly

lines.zh: 我等着，雪原上总会有人
lines.en: I wait, someone always comes to the snowfield

lines.zh: 我身上的黑，在白里很显眼
lines.en: The black on me stands out in the white
I laugh quietly once

lines.zh: 我脚下那一圈雪，一直没化
lines.en: The ring of snow at my feet has never melted
I fold my wings slowly
Dressed like that, standing in the snow

lines.zh: 我低头看你，我的脸在阴影里
lines.en: I look down at you, my face in shadow
You do not fear the cold, or me

lines.zh: 你身上有一点热度，我不喜欢
lines.en: There is a little warmth on you, I dislike it
I raise a hand, the fingertips ice
I stand, and you are at my feet.

lines.zh: 这一片雪原，我走了很多年
lines.en: I have crossed this snowfield many years

lines.zh: 你说的话，在冷空气里很清楚
lines.en: Your words are very clear in the cold air

lines.zh: 我这张脸，你看了不会忘
lines.en: You will not forget this face
You stepped back and the snow sounded
I am in no hurry, I am good at waiting
Your exhaled breath is going white
I spread my wings and block the snow glare.
Run, and the snow will still win

lines.zh: 我这只爪子，比你的手大
lines.en: This claw of mine is bigger than your hand
Hold there, let me have a look
A piece of ice fell off me
I give half a step, the snow sounds

lines.zh: 这一下，我的壳裂了一道
lines.en: That split my shell

lines.zh: 我没有叫，冷的人不会叫
lines.en: I did not cry out, the cold do not

lines.zh: 血是凉的，流出来就冻住
lines.en: The blood is cold, it freezes as it comes

lines.zh: 你看我的伤口，没有温度
lines.en: Look at my wound, there is no warmth
I will remember that
My wings have drooped a little

lines.zh: 我不觉得疼，只觉得不舒服
lines.en: I do not feel pain, only discomfort
Again would be the same

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，在雪里很显眼
lines.en: That thing in your hand shows plainly in the snow
I glance at it, no interest

lines.zh: 我吃的东西，和你的不一样
lines.en: What I eat is not what you eat

lines.zh: 你把东西举在雪上，手会冻
lines.en: Holding it over the snow will freeze your hand
I do not need it, keep it

lines.zh: 你以为喂我一次，就能走
lines.en: You think one feeding buys your way out
It is getting cold and you still hold it up
I reach out and take it for a look
I cannot tell what this is
Throw it away, stop holding it

lines.zh: 你的东西在雪里，很快就不能吃了
lines.en: Your thing will be inedible soon in this snow

lines.zh: 我伸手指碰了一下，它就凉了
lines.en: I touch it with a finger and it goes cold

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞到冰
lines.en: You hit me like hitting ice

lines.zh: 我被撞得晃了一下，脚没动
lines.en: The bump rocked me, my feet did not move
Your hand pulled back at the touch

lines.zh: 这一下，你的袖子冻硬了
lines.en: That froze your sleeve stiff
I shifted half a step to let you by
Do not press against me, it is cold here

lines.zh: 你退开后，雪上有一串脚印
lines.en: After you backed off, a line of prints in the snow

lines.zh: 我这一身骨头，比石头硬
lines.en: These bones of mine are harder than stone

lines.zh: 这一撞没什么，可你记住了
lines.en: That was nothing, and you will remember it

lines.zh: 我的冰壳硬过你的骨头。
lines.en: My ice shell is harder than your bones.
There are not many of my kind on the snowfield

lines.zh: 我在这一片走了很多年
lines.en: I have walked this stretch for many years

lines.zh: 这一身冰，碰一下会粘住
lines.en: This ice of mine sticks when touched
Closer and the ice will take hold of you
That does not interest me
I would rather keep my own company

lines.zh: 你看我这翅膀，不是用来抱人的
lines.en: These wings are not for holding anyone
Don't come close. It's cold on my side.
I am waiting for another snowfall

lines.zh: 我觉得这片雪地不适合你。
lines.en: This snowfield doesn't suit you.
I bend, stiffly
I pinch it up with a claw
Frost begins to form on it in my hand
This is so light it is useless

lines.zh: 它在我手里冻成了硬块。
lines.en: It froze into a lump in my hand.

lines.zh: 我举到眼前，看不出名堂
lines.en: I hold it to my eye and make nothing of it
I let go and it sinks into the snow.
It fell and the snow covered it
Everything in this stretch is frozen
You take it, I keep nothing
New prints in the snow
I turn my head, my neck slow
I saw you from far off
You should not have come to this stretch

lines.zh: 我把翅膀张开，完整地张开
lines.en: I spread my wings, fully
The cold begins to move your way

lines.zh: 你身上的热，在雪里很扎眼
lines.en: Your warmth stands out in this snow
This snowfield is mine
Frost begins to form on my fingertips.
Your steps are drawing out
I break the ice underfoot and close in slowly.
Snow breaks under my feet
I follow you, the snow keeps my prints
The further you go, the deeper the snow
There is no cover here

lines.zh: 我踩过的雪，都结了一层冰
lines.en: The snow I cross freezes over

lines.zh: 你的腿在雪里拔得很费劲
lines.en: Your legs are straining in the snow
I need not run, I am faster

lines.zh: 你往林子里去，那里也一样冷
lines.en: Head into the trees, it is as cold there
My wings sound in the wind
Your heat is falling

lines.zh: 每一次呼吸，你都慢一点
lines.en: Every breath makes you slower
I am in no hurry, you are the one freezing

lines.zh: 我在调整方向，一直在你前面
lines.en: I adjust my course, always ahead of you
One claw sweep, and cold

lines.zh: 这一下，你的护甲结了冰
lines.en: That iced over your armor
I press you into the snow

lines.zh: 我的手贴在你胸口，很凉
lines.en: My hand against your chest, very cold
You were knocked back, snow flying
That wound does not bleed
My wing knocks your hand aside
Your movements have slowed
I raked once, my nails are sharp
You retreat, the snow gives way
Now you know the cold
I have not used my strength

lines.zh: 冰刺之间多了一个影子
lines.en: A shape has appeared among the ice spikes
Several deep prints in the snow
I come around from behind a snow drift
The cold arrives first, then me

lines.zh: 我落地时，雪被压下去一片
lines.en: I land and a patch of snow sinks
I shake the frost off my wings
Someone is back on this snowfield
I stand, taller than the trees

lines.zh: 我的冷气先漫过这片雪原。
lines.en: The cold spills across the snowfield first.
The wind stopped, that is my arrival

lines.zh: 雪面被踩下去，声音很闷
lines.en: The snow presses down with a muffled sound
My wings cast a shadow first
Fire makes water run off me

lines.zh: 我从冰壁上掉下来，摔得很重
lines.en: I fell from the ice wall, hard

lines.zh: 水比雪暖，可我还是不喜欢
lines.en: Water is warmer than snow, and I still dislike it

lines.zh: 炸得我身上的冰全碎了
lines.en: The blast shattered all the ice on me

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进来，冻在肉里
lines.en: An arrow sank in and froze in the flesh

lines.zh: 那股劲儿在我身体里结了层霜
lines.en: That force left a layer of frost inside me

lines.zh: 雪原上没什么吃的，我饿
lines.en: Little to eat on the snowfield, I am hungry

lines.zh: 雷落在冰上，我整个亮了
lines.en: Lightning struck the ice and I lit up
No snow here, and no cold
